{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string with commas to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove the 6 QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
sales_clean = sales[sales['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Now, filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
# - `customer_segment` == 'new'
# - `channel` == 'paid_search'
filtered = sales_clean[(sales_clean['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (sales_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search')]

# Check the distribution of `status` in this group
print(filtered['status'].value_counts())

# Check the conversion rate including all orders, including refunded ones
conversion_rate = filtered['converted'].mean()

# Print the conversion rate
print(f'Conversion rate: {conversion_rate}')

# Confirm that `converted == 1` includes some refunded orders
refunded_converted_count = filtered[(filtered['status'] == 'refunded') & (filtered['converted'] == 1)].shape[0]
print(f'Number of refunded orders with converted == 1: {refunded_converted_count}')"}
